title: Northgate Protect Valuation Standard: Replacement Price of a Promoted or Price-Dropped Item
content:
For a Northgate Protect single-item plan, the registered limit of liability starts from the price it takes to replace the item at Northgate where the covered order line shows one. The order line is read from the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records: its selling price per unit before promotions, the item promotion discount on the line, and any price adjustment booked against the line.

## The rule

| What the covered order line carries | The registered limit starts from |
|---|---|
| An item promotion (a promotion discount above zero on the line) | The line's selling price per unit before promotions |
| A Northgate price-drop adjustment and no item promotion | The lowered Northgate unit price that adjustment matched |
| Neither | The covered item price recorded on the plan |

An item promotion governs whenever the line carries one, whether or not a price-drop adjustment is also booked on it.

## Combinations

| Item promotion on the line | Northgate price-drop adjustment on the line | Starting price |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Selling price per unit before promotions |
| Yes | No | Selling price per unit before promotions |
| No | Yes | Lowered Northgate unit price matched |
| No | No | Covered item price recorded on the plan |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

- A blender line sold at $90.00 per unit before promotions carries a promotion discount; the plan recorded a net price of $72.00. The registered limit starts from $90.00.
- A soundbar line without a promotion carries a Northgate price-drop adjustment matching a lowered price of $180.00 per unit; the plan recorded $210.00. The registered limit starts from $180.00.
- A monitor line with neither starts from the price the plan recorded.
